integrity: Analytic proof uses Young deficit and anti-periodic compactness; finite tests are corroborative, not certification of the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real exponent 1<p<infinity; parity and even-dimensional numerical-radius asymptotic only. No finite-n closed form except Hilbert exponent; not complex nor weighted generalizations. Historical equivalent formulations remain bibliographic risk.
title: Antiperiodic cyclic shifts have a sharp numerical-radius gap on real sequence spaces
